description.p: Capy Canvas is a cross-platform app for sketching, illustration and photography, with a powerful GPU-accelerated painting engine. Its brushes simulate real pencil, ink and paint, and it comes with the tools you need for professional line art and comics. Best of all, it's 100% free and all of the code is open source.
カピカンは、強力なGPU加速ペイントエンジンを備えた、スケッチ・イラスト・写真編集のためのクロスプラットフォームアプリです。ブラシは本物の鉛筆やインク、絵の具を再現し、本格的な線画や漫画制作に必要なツールもそろっています。しかも完全無料で、コードはすべてオープンソースです。
水豚画布是一款跨平台应用，配备强大的 GPU 加速绘画引擎，适用于速写、插画和照片编辑。画笔能模拟真实的铅笔、墨水和颜料，也提供专业线稿与漫画创作所需的工具。最棒的是，它完全免费，所有代码都已开源。
水豚画布是一款跨平台应用，配备强大的 GPU 加速绘画引擎，适用于速写、插画和照片编辑。画笔能模拟真实的铅笔、墨水和颜料，也提供专业线稿与漫画创作所需的工具。最棒的是，它完全免费，所有代码都已开源。
水豚畫布是一款跨平台應用程式，配備強大的 GPU 加速繪畫引擎，適用於速寫、插畫和照片編輯。筆刷能模擬真實的鉛筆、墨水和顏料，也提供專業線稿與漫畫創作所需的工具。最棒的是，它完全免費，所有程式碼都是開源的。
水豚畫布是一款跨平台應用程式，配備強大的 GPU 加速繪畫引擎，適用於速寫、插畫和照片編輯。筆刷能模擬真實的鉛筆、墨水和顏料，也提供專業線稿與漫畫創作所需的工具。最棒的是，它完全免費，所有程式碼都是開源的。
카피 캔버스는 강력한 GPU 가속 페인팅 엔진을 갖춘, 스케치·일러스트·사진 편집용 크로스 플랫폼 앱입니다. 브러시가 실제 연필과 잉크, 물감을 재현하고, 전문적인 선화와 만화 작업에 필요한 도구도 모두 갖췄습니다. 무엇보다 100% 무료이고 모든 코드가 오픈 소스입니다.

Capy Canvas es una aplicación multiplataforma para bocetos, ilustración y edición de fotos, con un potente motor de pintura acelerado por GPU. Sus pinceles simulan lápiz, tinta y pintura reales, e incluye las herramientas que necesitas para entintado profesional y cómics. Y lo mejor: es 100 % gratis y todo el código es abierto.

O Capy Canvas é um aplicativo multiplataforma para esboços, ilustração e edição de fotos, com um poderoso motor de pintura acelerado por GPU. Os pincéis simulam lápis, nanquim e tinta de verdade, e ele traz as ferramentas de que você precisa para line art profissional e quadrinhos. E o melhor: é 100% gratuito e todo o código é aberto.

O Capy Canvas é um aplicativo multiplataforma para esboços, ilustração e edição de fotos, com um poderoso motor de pintura acelerado por GPU. Os pincéis simulam lápis, nanquim e tinta de verdade, e ele traz as ferramentas de que você precisa para line art profissional e quadrinhos. E o melhor: é 100% gratuito e todo o código é aberto.

Capy Canvas adalah aplikasi lintas platform untuk sketsa, ilustrasi, dan edit foto, dengan mesin lukis canggih yang dipercepat GPU. Kuasnya meniru pensil, tinta, dan cat sungguhan, dan dilengkapi alat yang Anda butuhkan untuk line art profesional dan komik. Yang terbaik, aplikasi ini 100% gratis dan seluruh kodenya open source.

Capy Canvas est une application multiplateforme de croquis, d'illustration et de retouche photo, dotée d'un puissant moteur de peinture accéléré par GPU. Ses pinceaux reproduisent le crayon, l'encre et la peinture réels, et elle offre tous les outils nécessaires pour l'encrage professionnel et la BD. Le meilleur ? Elle est 100 % gratuite et tout son code est open source.

Capy Canvas ist eine plattformübergreifende App zum Skizzieren, Illustrieren und Bearbeiten von Fotos, mit einer leistungsstarken GPU-beschleunigten Mal-Engine. Die Pinsel simulieren echten Bleistift, Tinte und Farbe, und für professionelle Lineart und Comics sind alle nötigen Werkzeuge dabei. Das Beste daran: Capy Canvas ist zu 100 % kostenlos, und der gesamte Code ist Open Source.

Капи Канвас — кроссплатформенное приложение для скетчей, иллюстрации и обработки фото с мощным движком рисования с ускорением на GPU. Кисти имитируют настоящий карандаш, тушь и краски, а для профессионального лайнарта и комиксов есть все нужные инструменты. А главное — оно на 100% бесплатное, и весь его код открыт.

คาปิ แคนวาส เป็นแอปข้ามแพลตฟอร์มสำหรับสเก็ตช์ วาดภาพประกอบ และแต่งรูป พร้อมกลไกการลงสีอันทรงพลังที่เร่งความเร็วด้วย GPU แปรงจำลองดินสอ หมึก และสีจริง และมีเครื่องมือครบสำหรับงานลายเส้นและการ์ตูนระดับมืออาชีพ ที่ดีที่สุดคือใช้ฟรี 100% และโค้ดทั้งหมดเป็นโอเพนซอร์ส

Capy Canvas là ứng dụng đa nền tảng để phác thảo, minh họa và chỉnh sửa ảnh, với công cụ vẽ tăng tốc GPU mạnh mẽ. Cọ vẽ mô phỏng bút chì, mực và màu vẽ thật, kèm đủ công cụ cho line art chuyên nghiệp và truyện tranh. Tuyệt nhất là ứng dụng miễn phí 100% và toàn bộ mã nguồn đều mở.

Capy Canvas, güçlü bir GPU hızlandırmalı boyama motoruna sahip, eskiz, illüstrasyon ve fotoğraf düzenleme için çapraz platformlu bir uygulamadır. Fırçaları gerçek kurşun kalem, mürekkep ve boyayı taklit eder; profesyonel çizgi çalışması ve çizgi roman için gereken tüm araçlar da içinde. En güzeli de %100 ücretsiz olması ve tüm kodunun açık kaynak olması.

Capy Canvas è un'app multipiattaforma per schizzi, illustrazione e fotoritocco, con un potente motore di pittura accelerato dalla GPU. I suoi pennelli simulano matita, inchiostro e colori veri, e include tutti gli strumenti che servono per l'inchiostrazione professionale e i fumetti. E la cosa migliore: è gratis al 100% e tutto il codice è open source.

description.p: There's a lot in this release: over 1,600 commits since 1.0.15. Capy Canvas now works on phones, and is a lot faster and more reliable.

ul.li: New phone UI tailored for small screens
Startup and opening photos up to 5x faster
New display stack using disk instead of RAM for large images
Support for 1 gigapixel images
Better multi-GPU and graphics tablet support on Windows
New smoothing and taper algorithms for pens

description.p: As usual, please back up your artwork before upgrading.
More painting and editing tools on Windows.

ul.li: Edit vector layers and blend paint with new brush controls.
Float tools in bubbles and restore your workspace between sessions.
Try artistic filters and improved mask, color and number controls.
Recover the canvas after graphics errors and keep tools responsive.

description.p: Drawings and recovered sessions from 1.0.14 containing image layers may no longer be editable. Keep originals and export flattened PNGs before updating.
Redesigned pencils, charcoal, chalk, pastels and crayons respond to pressure, tilt and paper.

ul.li: Choose built-in papers or import textures, with adjustable lighting.
Calibrate pen pressure and set smoothing for each brush.
Create drawings with physical units and searchable presets.
Native Windows Arm64 and iPadOS 17.5+ support.
Sketch combines Layers and Properties in one drawer.

description.p: Copy and paste selected areas, layers and masks, or paste into a new drawing. Zoom, Hand, Rotate, recovery and Safari startup improve.
Imported and pasted images keep original pixels in Object layers until Rasterize Layer.
This beta changes the Object-layer format. Earlier Object-layer drawings cannot be edited in this version. Before updating, export flattened PNG copies and keep original drawing files.
This maintenance release improves Android downloads and delivery of test builds.

ul.li: Android downloads pass the latest Google Play signature checks.
Verified Android builds reach internal testers before closed-beta review.
iPad test builds reuse the signing identity for future updates.

description.p: Android downloads open without requiring installation through Google Play.

ul.li: Android updates keep the signing identity of existing installations.
The app name follows your language on supported platforms.
Title bar spacing follows the selected control size.

description.p: The Linux battery indicator works without access to system services.

ul.li: Flatpak installations no longer request access to UPower.
The battery indicator reads system batteries in the background and excludes connected accessories.

description.p: Linux software centers now show Capy Canvas in your language, with light and dark previews.

ul.li: Saving a read-only drawing opens a chooser so you can save an editable copy.
The battery indicator and clock follow your desktop in Flatpak installations.
Translated Histogram controls fit their labels.
Drawings with filters reopen correctly after restarting the app.

description.p: Capy Canvas is available as a Flatpak for Linux.

ul.li: Open the downloaded Flatpak installer in your software manager to install Capy Canvas.
Flatpak installations receive signed updates through your software manager.

description.p: A small update for Windows.

ul.li: The Windows uninstaller is signed, like the app and its setup program.

description.p: The first public beta of Capy Canvas, for Linux, Windows, macOS, iPad, Android tablets and the web.

ul.li: Enclose and Fill, under Lasso Fill, fills the empty areas inside a loop you draw.
Edit Color has a new layout on Windows, macOS and iPad, with color values you can type, drag to adjust and copy.
On macOS and iPad, tap a color fill's thumbnail, Paper included, to change its color.
Layer thumbnails have rounded corners everywhere, and filters use the same effects icon throughout.
Windows reopens all your windows at launch and asks about any drawing it could not restore.
The Windows color wheel stays smooth while panels resize, and Export Preview on Windows works again.
The Windows app and setup program are signed, and the Mac app is notarized by Apple.
